plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Communication Studies, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/communication-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Communication Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Catalog edition year is not displayed on the catalog site; 2026-2027 used as the current edition. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (4, 5, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; select from the approved General Education list and program recommendations; see advisor. The blank 3-unit row in semester 2 is shown without a course or footnote in the source. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
